title: Structural analysis of tailored fiber placement composite bolted joints
author: Leonardo Gonçalves Chiquita
abstract: This work presents the implementation of a progressive damage model in finite element models, in order to simulate the mechanical behavior of carbon fiber reinforced polymer bolted joints produced by the TFP method, developed at the IPF Institute. The simulations were performed on the Ansys APDL software and their results were compared with experimental results obtained in previous works carried out at the institute. These simulations provided results that correlated well with the experimental data and will be used in the future, after some modifications, with optimization methods to develop TFP parts with optimized fiber orientation.
